workspace.heroTitle: Switch between GitHub identities and browse every repository in one desktop workspace.
workspace.heroDescription: Authorize in your browser, keep tokens confined to the main process, and move across personal and organization repositories without leaving the shell.
workspace.sectionDescription: Manage GitHub accounts, authorize new identities, and browse repositories grouped by owner.
workspace.loadAccountsFailedTitle: GitHub accounts could not be restored.

emptyState.title: No GitHub accounts yet
emptyState.description: Add a GitHub account to unlock your personal and organization repositories inside Hagihub.
emptyState.secondary: Authorization uses GitHub Device Flow in your browser and supports multiple accounts at the same time.

accountSelector.title: Connected identities
accountSelector.description: Switch the active GitHub account or add another identity for a different repository set.
accountSelector.plaintextStorage: Token storage fell back to plaintext encryption because OS keychain encryption is unavailable on this device.

deviceFlow.title: Add GitHub account
deviceFlow.description: Finish the GitHub authorization in your browser. Hagihub keeps polling in the main process until GitHub confirms the login.
deviceFlow.browserHint: GitHub will ask you to enter the code above, then confirm the requested scopes.
deviceFlow.securityHint: Tokens are stored locally and stay inside the Electron main process when repository data is fetched.

steps.enter: 2. Enter the code shown on the left.
steps.finish: 3. Approve access, Hagihub will finish the login automatically.

repoList.title: Repository inventory
repoList.description: Hagihub fetches organizations first, then groups every repository by owner login.
repoList.loadingHint: Hagihub waits for every GitHub page before rendering the full list.
repoList.emptyDescription: GitHub returned an empty repository list. Check whether the authorized account has the required repo scope.
repoList.personalDescription: Repositories owned directly by the active account or not matched to a loaded organization.
repoList.organizationRepos: Repositories grouped under the active organization.

errors.startDeviceFlowFailed: Failed to start GitHub Device Flow.
errors.cancelDeviceFlowFailed: Failed to cancel GitHub Device Flow.
errors.removeAccountFailed: Failed to remove the GitHub account.
errors.switchAccountFailed: Failed to switch the active GitHub account.
errors.storageReset: Saved GitHub account data was reset because the local storage file was corrupted.
errors.openBrowserFailed: Hagihub could not open the GitHub authorization page.
errors.orgsPartialFailed: Organizations could not be loaded. Personal repositories are still available.
